R E S O L VE D I S S U E S FO R C . 0 . 3 3 . 0EnhancementsChapter 4: Resolved Issuesfor C.0.33.0. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . ....................................................................Note:Code is marked in the programs with the FinancialServices Issue Tracking (FSIT) number....................................................................This is the description of all issues included in this CDR. The issuesare provided in numerical order under two headings, Enhancementsand Non-Conformities.Enhancements......................................................114434EZD WC - Expand EZDataCapture to include WC line of businessBUSINESSADVANTAGE:The goal of this project is to design and implement a process thatprovides for the collection of form data during policy issuance andstores that data for use during subsequent transaction processingfor workers compensation.DESCRIPTION:The EZDataCapture process was developed for all Lines of Businessexcept Workers Compensation. This will add that functionality.RESOLUTION:Modifications have been made to the existing EzDataCapture func-tionality for ALR lines to now include Workers Compensation.DOCUMENTATION:•Tools Options Guide•New Business Policy Processing Guide©Copyright 2010 CSC. All Rights Reserved.POINT IN (C.0.33.0) Release Package27
R E S O L VE D I S S U E S FO R C . 0 . 3 3 . 0120150120150EZD - Add EZDataCapture “Data-Only” functionalityBUSINESSADVANTAGE:Users will be able to customize the screens to capture additionalinformation relates to the existing POINT IN screens.DESCRIPTION:Currently EZDataCapture only supports screens that are associatedwith and initiated from Forms attachment. Enhance this product toallow screens to be painted to collect missing policy data that is notrequired for or associated with Forms. This “Data-Only” screen willhave the ability to be launched from any screen that has a Submitbutton.RESOLUTION:Define a Data-only screen using the EZDataCapture utility. Thisscreen is linked to an existing screen by the JSP name. When theexisting screen is selected a new button (EzData) will appear on thescreen allowing for entry of data on the EZDataCapture Data-Onlyscreen.DOCUMENTATION:•Tools Options Guide•Policy Processing New Business (Forms chapter)128158WCP - Implement state of West Virginia as an NCCI stateBUSINESSADVANTAGE:Surcharges will be implemented for state of West Virginia which isno longer a monopolistic state.DESCRIPTION:For all new business, renewals, rewrites, endorsements with a policyinception date on or after 07/01/2008 West Virginia will be a Work-ers’ Compensation state and should be reported to NCCI.The enhancement is expected to achieve the following:1. State of West Virginia should be implemented as a Worker'sCompensation state.2. All three necessary surcharges need to be implemented forWest Virginia. These surcharges are:•Regulatory Surcharge•Deficit Reduction Surcharge•WV Fire and Casualty Surcharge28POINT IN (C.0.33.0) Release Package©Copyright 2010 CSC. All Rights Reserved.
R E S O L VE D I S S U E S FO R C . 0 . 3 3 . 0Non-ConformitiesRESOLUTION:Implemented state of West Virginia as Worker's Compensation Statein POINT IN system.Non-Conformities......................................................116337EZD - Double Quotes are not handled properly on the return from thehostBUSINESSIMPACT:Missing information.DESCRIPTION:When double quotes are entered as part of a text field they arestored properly on the AS/400, however, when returned for displayon the client they are not displayed and the text following the dou-ble quotes is truncated.RESOLUTION:Modified the jsp to place an escape character in front of doublequotes when they are encountered in the contents of a text field.116338EZD - Remove hard coded template from ezCapDetailShowMap.xsl andezCapShow.xsl replace with includeBUSINESSIMPACT:This will make the future modifications simpler for the date han-dling code.DESCRIPTION:This issue will correct a comment received during code review forthe original project to add EZDataCapture for CPP. The EzCapDe-tailShowMap.xsl and ezCapShow.xsl files both contained code tohandle date formatting. This code is available as an "include" so thisFSIT addresses removing the code from the stylesheets and replacingit with the include. This way the date handling code will be in oneplace which will make future modifications simpler.RESOLUTION:Modified the stylesheets to include the date template.©Copyright 2010 CSC. All Rights Reserved.POINT IN (C.0.33.0) Release Package29
R E S O L VE D I S S U E S FO R C . 0 . 3 3 . 0116341116341EZD WC - The asterisk indicating a required entry field is not printedBUSINESSIMPACT:User will not be able to identify the mandatory field since the aster-isk is not printing along with it.DESCRIPTION:The asterisk indicating a required field is not printing when all ofthe fields within a subtitle group do not have a label. The label isbeing calculated to a zero length leaving no space for the asterisk.RESOLUTION:Modified the label calculation to default to 20 to leave room for theasterisk to display.116705EZD - Problem with the Forms List Grid and EZDataCapture FormsBUSINESSIMPACT:User will not be able to see forms attached to a particular unit cor-rectly.DESCRIPTION:When the forms list grid is selected from the navigation panel andthen a specific form is selected for view from the grid the key usedto retrieve the data from the database is generated from the naviga-tion panel instead of the key from within the grid.Example: Policy contains CA insurance line with 25 units. A form isadded to unit number 20. If the forms list is selected from the navi-gation panel under unit number 10 the list of forms displayed con-tains the form that was entered for unit number 20, however, if youselect that form from the grid no data is displayed because the unitnumber used to retrieve the data from the database is 10.RESOLUTION:Modifications were made to use the key values form the grid displayinstead of the navigation pane.116874EZD - Utility Version action copies past the keyBUSINESSIMPACT:User will be confused with the record being copied for the version ofthe form.DESCRIPTION:Using the EZDataCapture utility when a form is versioned the firstrecord on the next form is also copied.RESOLUTION:Modifications were made to prevent reading past the key.30POINT IN (C.0.33.0) Release Package©Copyright 2010 CSC. All Rights Reserved.
R E S O L VE D I S S U E S FO R C . 0 . 3 3 . 0118796118796EZD - Filter the policy interest drop-down to contain only those thatapply to the formBUSINESSIMPACT:User will not be able identify the interest type to which a form isassociated since all the interest types will appear in the drop-down.DESCRIPTION:EZDataCapture forms that are associated with a policy interest needthe ability to specify which interest types to be associated with sothat the drop-down presented on the screen can be filtered.RESOLUTION:Modifications were made to allow the entry of policy interest typeswhen a screen is being defined. These values are then used whenpainting the screen to filter which policy interests are displayed inthe drop-down.119237EZD - EzData Forms modified on endorsement are not printingBUSINESSIMPACT:The form modified during endorsement will not print with thechanges.DESCRIPTION:When a policy is endorsed and the EzData is modified for a form, theform is not printing. Update the WC FormAdded indicator to a ‘Y’when an EzDataCapture form is modified on endorsement.RESOLUTION:Modifications were made to the extract process to check the updatedate on the EzData forms and if it falls within the cycle dates therecord place on the extract indicates that the form is new so it willbe printed by Document Production.127841EZD - Unable to add more data on policy form created through EZ Datacapture with default logicBUSINESSIMPACT:User is unable to enter the data into the EZDataCapture form.DESCRIPTION:There is a problem with the default logic in the program because ofwhich the document doesn't have a Y under the EZ Screen field.STEPS TORECREATE:1. Create a form CG2412 – entries from TBEZCAP with default PCOand State.2. Create a policy and try access the Form List Screen.©Copyright 2010 CSC. All Rights Reserved.POINT IN (C.0.33.0) Release Package31
R E S O L VE D I S S U E S FO R C . 0 . 3 3 . 01286983. The form should have a Y in EZ Scrn field and have a drop-down that would allow to enter the data in the form.RESOLUTION:Modified the 99 default logic for the LOC, MCO & PCO combination.128698EZD - Processing messages are not shown when submitting changes andform titles are not displayed in EZDataCaptureBUSINESSIMPACT:Confirmation is not given to a user when a change has been done toa screen in EZDataCapture.DESCRIPTION:The processing messages are no longer shown when different trans-actions are done within EZDataCapture. When a screen is expired,copied, or deleted, the user doesn't receive a message that confirmsthat this function was done correctly.STEPS TORECREATE:Test 1: Name of screen should display1. Go to Main Menu > Tool Maintenance > EZDataCapture.2. Click Display button.3. Select Text next to any form from the drop-down.4. Form name should be displayed not Supplemental Form Data.Test 2: Map a form1. Go to Main Menu > Tool Maintenance > EZDataCapture.2. Click Display button.3. Find a verified form and select Map from the drop-down.4. Once the screen comes up, click Generate Excel button.5. Type in an email address and click Send Email.TRESOLUTION:Changed the Definition of TITLE1 for correct and complete displayof the Title.134702EZD - The Name field does not become active after reset when Title isentered in it onceBUSINESSIMPACT:User will not be able to enter any data in the name field if onceTitle has been entered in that field and it has been reset.32POINT IN (C.0.33.0) Release Package©Copyright 2010 CSC. All Rights Reserved.
R E S O L VE D I S S U E S FO R C . 0 . 3 3 . 0134945DESCRIPTION:Issue#1When a user enters Title in the name field by mistake and then resetthe data, the name field remains disabled and the user cannot enterany data on that screen in the name field. The only option availablefor the user is to click on the 'Cancel' button and go back and thenagain Add the element. This will happen only in the case of Titlename element since the field disables after entering Title and doesnot activate on resetting the data.Issue#2When map option is taken for a form, the screen which gets dis-played has some extra text at the right side of the screen which willbe confusing for the user.STEPS TO RECREATE:Issue # 11. Click on New Element.2. Enter Title in the name field and tab out.3. Click on the Reset Button.4. The name field will not be activated and user will not be ableto enter anything in the field.Issue # 21. Select 'Map' option for a form.2. Verify the screen that gets displayed.RESOLUTION:Changed the code in EzcDetailElement.jsp to make sure the 'Name'field is not disabled after Reset button is clicked.134945EZD - The text alignment for the labels with and without asterisk is notcorrect on the EZData capture screensBUSINESSIMPACT:This does not conform to the POINT IN screen standards.DESCRIPTION:When a screen is designed using EZDataCapture utility having somefields as mandatory and some fields as optional, the text of thelabels for these fields is not aligned as per POINT standards which isincorrect.STEPS TORECREATE:1. Design a screen using EZDataCapture having text as optionalfield, date as required field and number as required field.2. Finalize the screen.©Copyright 2010 CSC. All Rights Reserved.POINT IN (C.0.33.0) Release Package33

Access the screen in the Test mode and verify the alignment ofthe text.RESOLUTION:Modified the Label positioning for correct display.134949EZD - Multiple issues found with EZdata Capture screensBUSINESSIMPACT:Various usability issues for the users using EZDataCapture screens.DESCRIPTION:Issue # 1 - If the data is not entered in the first optional field onthe EZData screen but is entered in all other fields. After submittingthe screen, the data gets mixed up and all the data gets displayedin the first field which was optional and was left blank.Issue # 2 - When any element is opened in Display mode, threefields on the screen Data Type, Stored in Field and Stored in Seq areenterable which is incorrect since they are supposed to be read onlyfields.Issue # 3 - The text is not properly aligned with the check box onthe EZData screen when the Data type is check box.STEPS TORECREATE:Issue#11. Design a screen having first field as optional and other fieldsas required.2. Enter data in all fields except for the first optional fields.3. Submit the screen and verify the data entered in all the fields.Issue#21. Select Display option for any EZDataCapture element.2. Verify the Data Type, Stored in Field and Stored in Seq fieldsfor the entry of data.Issue#31. Create an element having check box.2. Access the screen in the test mode.3. Verify the alignment of the text with the check box.RESOLUTION:Corrected the screen settings for correct display and also the hostmodules to make sure the data gets stored correctly.34POINT IN (C.0.33.0) Release Package©Copyright 2010 CSC.
